name: meant-profile-consent-pocketic
description: W4: the example SNS validator canister registered with the real SNS governance canister on PocketIC; W0: the ICP MCP example canister (examples/icp-mcp, D-061).

scripts.build: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path ../rust/Cargo.toml --example sns_validator --example sns_target && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path ../../../examples/icp-mcp/canister/Cargo.toml
scripts.test: npm run fetch && npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 "test/*.test.mjs"
